faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRDO DIBT recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DRDO DIBT recruitment is 24 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies, with 1 for Research Associate and 4 for Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: A PhD in Food Processing Engineering, Food Engineering & Technology, or Food Engineering is required. Experience in AI/ML/Simulation tools is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree (MSc) in the first division with a valid NET/GATE score, or a Post Graduate Degree (M.Tech) in the first division is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years, with relaxations for SC/ST and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Research Associate and JRF?
faq.answer: Research Associates will receive Rs. 67,000/- + HRA per month, and JRFs will receive Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the DRDO DIBT recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Interview, and the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q9. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in Offline mode by sending the application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article.
